title: E04 confirmatory pass: does deferred tool discovery still cut tokens on a frozen, never-used holdout?
hypothesis: The E04 dev run found deferred tool discovery 27% cheaper with equal quality (token CI excluding zero), while the earlier E04 two-arm run found no difference. One of the two is noise. On a fresh holdout that neither run has seen, deferred is non-inferior in quality and not more expensive than direct; codemode_only is likewise non-inferior and not more expensive.

task_cluster_definition.fairness_check: each task graded unsolved (exit 1) and with a reference solution (exit 0) before the run
task_cluster_definition.cluster: one task is one cluster; both tasks are new and were never seen by any prior run
task_cluster_definition.dev_suite_note: already consumed by the E04 dev run; not reused here

model_identity_observability.note: same model for all arms; absolute token claims carry the model identity

quality_margin.rule: quality non-inferior within 5pp before any cost claim

noise_and_power_plan.statement: 2 clusters cannot establish a distribution; this pass can only contradict or fail to contradict the dev result, and a CI that crosses zero is reported as inconclusive
noise_and_power_plan.plan: 6 runs; same model, temperature 0, arm order alternated by task index

cache_order_design.order: arm order alternated by task index
cache_order_design.cache: provider-side cache state is not controllable and is not claimed

stopping_rule: stop after 6 runs or 400k tokens, whichever comes first

holdout_policy.retirement_action: this suite becomes validation; a new one must be frozen before another confirmatory claim
holdout_policy.prior_use: none - suite-holdout-e04.json is new and has never been run; the E07 holdout is a different file and is already retired
